executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $156.8 per resident day (45.0% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $7,358,880 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 26,628 Medicaid days, $276.36 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $281.55 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $305.49 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 15.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $405,987, 5.9% of the $6,910,897 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,161,862, $26.36 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $546,254 (47.0%), allocated fringe $139,757 (12.0%), non-wage costs $475,851 (41.0%). Raw food was $425,475 ($9.65 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $346.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $401,652, $9.11 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $285,142 (71.0%), allocated fringe $72,952 (18.2%), non-wage costs $43,558 (10.8%).

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 7 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $978 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Interest Expense (page 27 line 12D), added $30,098; Medical Director (page 13 line B8a), removed $19,718; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $6,927. Separately, the home itself removed $1,557,407 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
